description: Create a presigned upload URL for an image asset. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image; use one of the allowed values.

participantId.description: Challenge participant ID, from a challenge participant listing.
